name: Delicate Arch
why: Over bare slickrock and along a ledge to Utah's symbol, a free-standing arch on the rim of a sandstone bowl, red at sunset.
book: Timed-entry reservation for the park in the high season (recreation.gov). Parking at Wolfe Ranch fills by mid-morning.
water: None, no shade: carry 2 litres, more in summer.
dangers: Heat over 38°C in summer on open slickrock.
Steep drop-offs on the last ledge and in the bowl.
Bring a headlamp for the walk back after sunset.

points.name: Wolfe Ranch
points.note: An 1890s settler's cabin; Ute petroglyphs a short side path away.

points.name: Delicate Arch
points.note: A 16 m arch on the edge of a slickrock bowl, the La Sal Mountains behind.
